public_rationale: This claim joins several parts with 'and'. The firm part, that generative AI 'isn't making anybody any money', was false when he wrote it. Nvidia reported $14.9 billion of GAAP net income in the quarter ending April 2024. Its CEO credited demand for generative AI training and inference. One clearly false part makes the whole statement false as written. The jobs and 'new ways to work' parts are harder to measure. Paid use of GitHub Copilot (1.8 million subscribers) and fast growth in AI-skill job postings cut against them, but these do not settle them for generative AI alone. The 'path to revenue is unclear' part is a judgment and was not scored.
limitations: Nvidia figures come from a news report of the release.
The jobs evidence covers AI broadly, not only generative AI.
The jobs and work-method parts were not decisively tested.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Generative AI is not creating new jobs or new ways of working, is not making money, and has no clear path to higher revenue.

statement.excerpt: Generative AI isn't creating new jobs, it isn't creating new ways to do your job, and it isn't making anybody any money — and the path to boosting revenues is unclear.

from_speaker: Generative AI isn't creating new jobs
isn't creating new ways to do your job
the path to boosting revenues is unclear
our_interpretation: Plain reading: as of July 2024, generative AI had not created jobs or new ways of working, and nobody was earning money from it.
The claim joins several parts with 'and'. It is false if any firm part is clearly false.
'The path to boosting revenues is unclear' is a judgment and is not scored.
He named no period. I use 2024-01-01 to 2024-07-08, the latest period reported before the post.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence that, in the first half of 2024, no company made meaningful money from generative AI and no jobs or working methods could be traced to it.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Company-reported results from the first half of 2024 showing substantial profit or revenue from generative AI. Clear evidence of new generative AI jobs or new working methods would also count.

evidence.excerpt: Nvidia's GAAP net income for Q1 FY 2025 was $14.881 billion, up 21% from $12.285 billion in the previous quarter and up a whopping 628% from $2.043 billion in the same quarter a year before.
evidence.explanation: Nvidia earned large profits in the quarter ending April 2024. Read with e2, this contradicts 'isn't making anybody any money'.

evidence.excerpt: "Our datacenter growth was fueled by strong and accelerating demand for generative AI training and inference on the Hopper platform," said Jensen Huang
evidence.explanation: The company credits generative AI demand for its record growth.

evidence.excerpt: Microsoft's GitHub Copilot code-generation tool now has 1.8 million paid subscribers
evidence.locator: paragraph after the capacity bottleneck note
evidence.explanation: 1.8 million people paid for a generative AI coding tool. That suggests some new ways of doing work and some revenue. It is context, not a measure of new jobs.

evidence.excerpt: PwC research also finds that growth in jobs demanding AI skills has outpaced all jobs since 2016, with postings for jobs requiring AI skills growing 3.5x faster than for all jobs.
evidence.explanation: Job postings that require AI skills grew fast. This covers AI broadly, not generative AI alone, so it does not settle the jobs part.
